name: Distracted Shot (Ex)
body:
Benefit: A rogue with this talent knows how to take advantage of her opponents when they are distracted by her allies. When a target is engaged in melee, the rogue may spend a guile point as a swift action to make that enemy flat-footed to her first ranged attack that round.
